offer.title: React Developer
offer.body:
Not a small start-up where nothing happens. A large, stable platform for a Swiss client, and the companies using it are global brands.

The project

The client runs several React applications and you would work on developing them further.

How the cooperation works

  • B2B contract only. You run your own business and invoice us. We do not offer an employment contract (umowa o pracę) and we are not able to change that.

  • You work day to day with the client's team. This is not solo work, you coordinate with other people every day and you do it in English.

What we expect

  • At least 7 years of commercial React experience

  • Excellent programming skills in JavaScript-based technologies

  • Solid know-how in TypeScript and Next.js

  • Experience with REST APIs and embedding React components on external pages

  • Good code practices

  • Well-established AI workflows in your daily work

  • You care about your work and see it as more than just code

  • You communicate comfortably in English, written and spoken. You use it every day with the client.

Nice to have

  • Experience with authentication across domains

What we offer

  • A long, stabile cooperation on a project that is already running and stable, not a three-month engagement.

  • You work directly with the client's team. We do not put a project manager between you and them.

  • Remote work, or our office in Wrocław if you prefer to have one.

  • 10 days to pay your invoice.

About us

USEO has been building web applications since 2009. What that means for you: we are small, so there are no layers of management, and our projects run for years rather than for a quarter, so you get to see the consequences of your own decisions.

Almost all of our clients come from referrals. Rated 5.0 on Clutch.

How to apply

Send your CV. A link to your LinkedIn profile is always welcome, it usually tells us more than a CV does.
